meta.title: Vendor participates in a live event and submits the Quote sheet
gaps: Verify that every mandatory field across all quote-sheet sections was individually filled before submission.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every mandatory field across all quote-sheet sections was individually filled before submission.

steps.note: Create the live event used by the vendor-side test.
Give the event a searchable title.
Configure the event with an RFQ quote stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Populate the buyer-side pricing sheet so the vendor receives a usable quote sheet.
Invite the QA vendor who will use the supplier portal.
Make the event live and visible to the invited vendor.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the separate supplier-portal session for the invited vendor.
Open the live event card and land on the vendor's Event Overview.
Accept participation from the vendor's Event Overview.
Open the RFQ quote sheet after participating.
Fill the vendor quote sheet and submit the quote.
Verify the vendor sees the submitted response confirmation.
